children: Egyptian developer Midyan Developments plans to invest 12 billion Egyptian pounds ($224.59 million) in education and healthcare projects over the next four years, the company's CEO said.
Ahmed Lotfy Soliman told Zawya Projects that the investments would cover three sectors: pre-university education, higher education and healthcare.
The company plans to open an international school in Alexandria in September 2027, with a capacity of 1,750 students, followed by a second school in September 2028, he said.
Midyan Developments is also constructing Mediterranean University in Alexandria, which will comprise six facilities and have a capacity of 10,700 students.
The developer is additionally building a 250-bed university hospital affiliated with Mediterranean University, Soliman said.
(Reporting by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
